m1.title: THE ANCHOR CHANGE: re-anchor tasks.context.imperative to the act, not the artifact
m1.imperative: Highest-value item in the gate. Do NOT touch tasks.context.context_refs -- it is pinned as a literal by tests/test_context_manifest.py -- and keep every declared context_refs path verbatim in the imperative or tests/test_context_declaration_lint.py fails. Write the new wiring test file first, observe it RED, then make it green.

m2.title: verify-frame in scripts/map_orient.py -- ABSENT frame refuses first
m2.imperative: Add the verify-frame subcommand reading .agent-work/<work-id>/MISSION_FRAME.md plus the receipt orient wrote. Write the ABSENT-frame refusal test FIRST (the single most important negative case: an absent frame must never vacuously pass), then the rest of the matrix: resolved-and-valid passes; an unknown anchor refuses NAMING it; an all-source-path frame refuses as cut-from-code. Reuse the frozen exit-code vocabulary from g1 -- no new codes -- and keep the reserved-first-line contract. Do not print the map inventory: only ids the frame itself cited may be echoed.

m3.title: Partial independent oracle for the degraded case: the fixed fallback set
m3.imperative: Add a fixed, corpus-declared fallback search order (README.md, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, a docs/ index) that orient PROBES on the filesystem and records in the receipt, and label each declared substitute known-fallback (in the set AND present on disk -- verified by an oracle the agent does not author) vs agent-declared (unverified). Wire the degraded arm of verify-frame to the hash-pinned substitutes: a degraded frame must cite at least one declared substitute, and citing a known-fallback path the receipt never declared refuses. Test BOTH labels. Do not describe this as closing the self-attestation gap -- it converts half of it.

m4.title: Wire the contract into COMMANDER_SPINE.template.json -- asymmetrically
m4.imperative: verify-orientation becomes a command postcondition c2 on the CONTEXT step; verify-frame becomes a command postcondition on the PLAN step. verify-frame must NOT run at context -- no frame exists there, and making an absent frame pass at context would destroy m2's ABSENT-frame refusal. Record that reasoning in the imperative PROSE so a future implementer sees the road not to take. Use <repo-root>, never a relative path (#341 is out of scope). Give the plan check override_policy {allowed:true, authority:human, reason_required:true} so a trivial-change escape is a recorded waiver; keep the context check tighter (no policy). Keep gate-vs-report flag-flippable. Name the frame path the plan step must write so the check is satisfiable.
